# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest version on the `main` branch.

## Generated applications

This policy and the contact below belong to the **upstream template**. Before using a generated repository, its owner must replace the reporting contact with a monitored private channel for that application and define its supported versions and response expectations. Enable GitHub private vulnerability reporting if it is available for your repository, or provide a private security email. Repository settings and contacts are not configured by `pnpm setup` or inherited from the template.

Report application-specific issues (including deployed sessions, data, credentials and backend authorization) to the application owner. Report reproducible defects in the shared template to upstream, without sending application secrets or customer data. Each generated application's owner is responsible for dependency updates and applying upstream fixes; generated repositories are independent and do not receive them automatically.

## Reporting an upstream vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use the
repository's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/ivo-gavran/ultra-next-template/security/advisories/new)
and include reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation.

You can expect an acknowledgement within five business days. Details should
remain private until a fix is available and a coordinated disclosure date has
been agreed.
